changelog: - **A saved Monte Carlo distribution is no longer shown as current when a Parameter's value was changed in the Workspace file.** Since Parameters became simulation inputs (a connection's amount written as `@p`), a Workspace whose Parameter value was edited outside the app, or whose results block was moved onto a sibling file with another value, imported its distribution as current although the simulation now moves a different amount. The file check now sees the value: such a result loads marked "graph changed" with Export disabled, and a new run clears it. One-time effect: a Workspace saved before this release whose diagram has a Parameter shows its saved distribution as "graph changed" once on import; re-run to refresh. Files without a Parameter are unaffected.
